name: Firecrawl
summary: Turn any website into clean markdown for a model: crawl whole domains, extract structured fields, respect robots.
description:
Firecrawl solves the unglamorous step in retrieval-heavy products — getting the text out of the web in a form a model can read. Give it a URL and it returns markdown; give it a site and it crawls with limits; the extract mode pulls structured fields out of unstructured pages. The self-hostable core and the API-first design are why it gets adopted quickly by builders.

Rate limits, anti-bot walls and JavaScript-heavy pages are the honest failure modes, and they arrive unevenly by target site. Legal and ethical use is yours to own: crawling is polite until it is a load test, and content you scrape into a corpus has provenance questions you should answer before, not after.
